remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom townhome, offering the perfect blend of modern living and convenience. Step into the open living space, ideal for entertaining or relaxing, with plenty of natural light and a seamless flow between rooms. The kitchen and bathrooms have been tastefully updated, featuring modern finishes and fixtures to enhance your daily life.  You'll love the convenience of the attached 2-car garage, providing ample storage and parking. Located in the heart of town, this home is just minutes away from schools, vibrant shopping, dining, offices, and public transportation. Whether you're commuting to work or enjoying a night out, everything you need is right at your fingertips.  Don't miss the opportunity to make this well-maintained, centrally-located townhome your own!
